imagery.notes: Start with already cleared published Qualla imagery. Public-domain/CC0 only. Candidate labels are not final original-source approval; skip questionable images without a source question.

policy.ownership: Every structure-catalog candidate/collection member is excluded,including existing imports.
policy.quality: Recognizable medium-fi exterior. Complete construction,focused visual/runtime review,placement,catalog and story sync in one cycle. Approximate unseen non-defining detail; do not launch repeated reference/terrain research campaigns.
policy.selection: Round robin by region across independently named unmodeled buildings. Prefer varied countries and building categories. Prior fixed targets, registered catalog matches and other-device reservations excluded. Published Qualla public-domain candidates screened before selection; each subject and source still requires inspection at authoring.
